speaker: ORAC
text: Mark lost those coordinates to you in a card game. He told you not to come.

speaker: JASON
text: He survived. If this works, Stacy and I get a better life.

speaker: ORAC
text: He also left you a stash near the yard. I have the location saved.

speaker: JASON
text: Then let's find it. Take us down.

speaker: ORAC
text: I can't. While Mark's codes make us appear as a maintenance drone, I have to answer every challenge the defense grid sends. It's complex and relentless. It takes everything I have. You'll have to fly.

speaker: ORAC
text: Follow the orange gate. Blue rings show the route ahead. Miss once and the old defenses notice us. Miss twice and they fire.

speaker: ORAC
text: You have control. Keep us in the corridor.
